title: Medical Regulatory Bodies & Health Missions
description: National medical regulatory/standards bodies and health missions plus Telangana and Andhra Pradesh state medical councils, health service parastatals, and state health missions.
scope_note: Covers bodies that regulate, accredit, or administer public health delivery infrastructure.

provenance.collection_method: WebSearch-based knowledge engineering research. Direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.edu.in/Wikipedia domains remained blocked by this session's organizational egress policy during RC2 as well (re-confirmed HTTP 403 live before enrichment began).
provenance.confidence_calibration_note: RC2 raised confidence modestly (max +8/row) where stronger multi-source corroboration was found, capped at 88 — still below a 90+ 'direct official source' band, since WebFetch access was not restored.

license: Compiled from public government, institutional, and reputable healthcare-journalism sources for ValueWeave internal knowledge-graph use; per-row source attribution preserved in source_url.
